item.text: {"search_note":"I searched directly for Tinubu + nuclear safety / safeguards / custody / accident prevention and found regulatory and safety-control evidence, but not a public Tinubu statement using the exact language of command-and-control discipline for nuclear weapons, since Nigeria is not a nuclear weapons state.\n\nSo the best-supported reading is: yes on safeguards and accident prevention, but via civilian nuclear regulation and hazardous-material safety rather than weapons command-and-control.","evidence":[{"title":"PRESIDENT TINUBU SIGNS FOUR NEW NUCLEAR SAFETY REGULATIONS","publisher":"Nigerian Nuclear Regulatory Authority (NNRA)","date":"2024 (NNRA page; published after the regulations were endorsed in 2024)","url":"https://www.nnra.gov.ng/nnra/post-president_tinubu_signs_four_new_nuclear_safety_regulations","summary":"Tinubu signed four new nuclear safety regulations covering nuclear power plant design/construction, transport of radioactive material, basic ionizing radiation, and radioactive waste/spent fuel management. This is the strongest direct evidence that he strengthened nuclear custody, safety, and accident-prevention controls.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.1"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Mourns Victims of Tanker Fire Incident in Rivers State","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"April 28, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-mourns-victims-of-tanker-fire-incident-in-rivers-state/","summary":"After a fatal petroleum-tanker fire, Tinubu directed federal agencies to support victims and said stricter safety regulations for transporting petroleum products would be implemented to prevent similar tragedies. This is a direct accident-prevention signal, though outside the nuclear field.","question_ids":["1B.3"]},{"title":"President Tinubu: Mineral Resources Exploration Mist Prioritize Health and Safety of Nigerians","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"August 8, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-mineral-resources-exploration-mist-prioritize-health-and-safety-of-nigerians/","summary":"Tinubu said mineral exploration must prioritize the health and safety of Nigerians and host communities, and he ordered a crackdown on illegal miners. This supports a broader pattern of safety and regulatory discipline around hazardous activities.","question_ids":["1B.3"]}]}
